 'a+b*t^c+(d+e t)P^p': (lambda p,t,P: p[0]+p[1]*t**p[2]+(p[3]+p[4]*t)*P**p[5]+p[6]*t*P**p[7] if False else p[0]+p[1]*t**p[2]+(p[3]+p[4]*t)*P**p[5], 6),

 'richards r(t) K const + exp src': (lambda p: p[0]*np.exp(-p[1]*t)+p[2]+ (p[3]+p[4]*t)*P*(1-np.abs(P/p[5])**p[6]), 7),

 'r P(1-P/K)+S exp, P^p': (lambda p: p[0]+p[1]*np.exp(-p[2]*t) + p[3]*P - p[4]*P**p[5] + p[6]*t*P, 7),
}
